verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ בְּב֣וֹא הַ֭זִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְשָׁא֑וּל הֲלֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃ אֱ֭לֹהִים בְּשִׁמְךָ֣ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ תְדִינֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nōṯ maś·kîl lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·ḇō·w haz·zî·p̄îm way·yō·mə·rū lə·šā·’ūl hă·lō ḏā·wiḏ mis·tat·têr ‘im·mā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·šim·ḵā hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ū·ḇiḡ·ḇū·rā·ṯə·ḵā ṯə·ḏî·nê·nî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments A Maskil of David When the Ziphites went to Saul and said Is David not hiding among us Save me O God by Your name and vindicate me by Your might
verses.literalPt: SALVA-ME, ó Deus, pelo teu nome, e faze-me justiça pelo teu poder.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁמַ֣ע תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.literal: Hear my prayer O God listen to the words of my mouth
verses.literalPt: Ó Deus, ouve a minha oração, inclina os teus ouvidos às palavras da minha boca.

verses.original: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים׀ קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî zā·rîm qā·mū ‘ā·lay wə·‘ā·rî·ṣîm biq·šū nap̄·šî lō śā·mū ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·neḡ·dām se·lāh
verses.literal: For strangers rise up against me and ruthless men seek my life men with no regard . . . for God Selah
verses.literalPt: Porque os estranhos se levantam contra mim, e tiranos procuram a minha vida; não têm posto Deus perante os seus olhos. (Selá.)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.literal: Surely God is my helper the Lord is the sustainer of my soul
verses.literalPt: Eis que Deus é o meu ajudador, o Senhor está com aqueles que sustêm a minha alma.

verses.literal: He will reward my enemies with evil In Your faithfulness destroy them
verses.literalPt: Ele recompensará com o mal os meus inimigos. Destrói-os na tua verdade.

verses.original: בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה־ לָּ֑ךְ א֤וֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: bin·ḏā·ḇāh ’ez·bə·ḥāh- lāḵ ’ō·w·ḏeh šim·ḵā Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Freely I will sacrifice to You I will praise Your name O LORD for it is good
verses.literalPt: Eu te oferecerei voluntariamente sacrifícios; louvarei o teu nome, ó SENHOR, porque é bom,

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִכָּל־ צָ֭רָה הִצִּילָ֑נִי וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî mik·kāl ṣā·rāh hiṣ·ṣî·lā·nî ū·ḇə·’ō·yə·ḇay rā·’ă·ṯāh ‘ê·nî
verses.literal: For He has delivered me from every trouble and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes
verses.literalPt: Pois me tem livrado de toda a angústia; e os meus olhos viram o meu desejo sobre os meus inimigos.
